result.title: API Validation Rule Update - Q3 2024 Incident Response
result.content:
## Decision: Update API Validation Rules

Based on the Q3 2024 incident postmortem and lessons learned, the following API validation rules have been updated to strengthen our API governance framework:

### Key Changes:

1. **72-Hour Advance Notice for Limit Changes**: All modifications to rate limits, quotas, or API thresholds must now include a 72-hour advance notification to all API consumers. This prevents sudden service disruptions caused by unexpected threshold adjustments.

2. **30-Day Deprecation Notice for Breaking Changes**: Any breaking API changes must now include a mandatory 30-day deprecation notice period. This gives consumers adequate time to update their integrations before the breaking change takes effect.

3. **Rate Limit Headers in All Responses**: All API responses must now include rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) to provide real-time visibility into rate limit status to API consumers.

### Rationale:

The root cause of the Q3 2024 incident was inadequate advance warning to API consumers before rate limit threshold adjustments. These updated validation rules address this critical gap by establishing clear communication and notification protocols for all API changes.

### Implementation:

These validation rules are now enforced at the API gateway level and must be validated by all API deployments going forward. API validation procedures have been updated to reflect these new requirements.

### Status:

Decision approved and implemented as of Q3 2024 postmortem resolution.
